responsibility: This file implements LTO symbol-table and callgraph merging after multiple input files have been read. It resolves prevailing declarations and definitions, replaces duplicate cgraph and varpool nodes, redirects callers and references, handles alias/weakref and COMDAT merging, reconciles TLS models and virtual tables, drops or externalizes preempted definitions when required by linker resolution, and leaves GCC’s unified symtab/cgraph in a consistent post-merge state for IPA and code generation.
same_name_distinction: Implements the symbol-table merge operations themselves—replacing duplicate cgraph/varpool nodes, resolving aliases and preemption, and choosing prevailing definitions—whereas gcc/lto/lto-symtab.h only exposes the merge entry points and inline prevailing-decl helpers.
